title: Bank account
titleCn: 银行开户对话（雅思听力Part1）

paragraphs.text: Part one. You will hear a man talking to a woman at a bank. First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.
Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.
Good morning. I'd like to open a bank account, please.
Certainly. If you'd like to take a seat, I'll just get some information on our different options for you. It won't take long.

I've got the application form for you here. I see you've already got our leaflet. As you can see, we have different types of accounts. Is it a current account or a deposit account you want to open today?

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
deposit account, I suppose.

00:00:59,620

Could you tell me a little more about this type of account? The interest rate, for instance.

00:01:05,800

Sure. Our interest rate is 3.4%, which is actually 1.3% higher than other banks. So opening account here is a good choice if you want to save.

00:01:17,460

And if I wanted to withdraw around fifty thousand dollars, would I need to wait?

00:01:23,060

No, but when you withdraw more than one million dollars, it would be a different process. In the past, you had to give a notice 60 days in advance, but things are a little different here. You only need to give a 30 days notice.

00:01:38,460

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
see. That's great.

00:01:40,720

Can I ask, how much will you be opening your account with? We usually ask for a minimum sum of 300 dollars, but if you have more than 600 dollars, you'll have a better interest rate.

00:01:53,080

Well, I'm going to transfer one thousand dollars from my Dash account just until I get paid.

00:01:59,660

That's not a problem.

00:02:01,280

Great. How long should it take to arrange a debit card? A week?

00:02:06,160

I'm afraid not. The general process of opening the account needs 10 working days, but it's usually quite fast. It takes most banks two more days than us.

00:02:17,540

That's good to know. What should I do if I need to close this account? Do I come back to you or...?

00:02:25,160

I'm afraid not. My duty as an account administrator is to open the account for you. You'd need to talk to the branch manager about that matter.

00:02:34,520

And what's the best way to withdraw cash?

00:02:37,620

Well, as this is a deposit account, if you need cash, there are two ways to do that. One is through any ATM of our bank at your convenience. Our bank tellers can also handle a cash withdrawal, but you need to bring your identification.

00:02:54,240

All right. I will keep that in mind.

00:02:57,740

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten. Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

00:03:26,620

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
also want to inquire about insurance.

00:03:29,440

Oh, yes, I forgot to mention that. Deposit accounts with over fifty thousand dollars come with a life insurance policy free of charge. But if you already have that type of insurance, then you can change the policy to house insurance if you like.

00:03:44,900

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
see. I guess I would go for the latter one.

00:03:48,720

Hmm, take your time to think about it. You can let us know if you change your mind. If you're interested, we also have investment schemes available. You can find information about that option in your leaflet. Just give us a call if you want to know more.

00:04:05,060

Thanks. I think I'll just open the account today.

00:04:09,420

If I want to apply for a credit card, can I also do that today?

00:04:14,460

Yes, but there is an interview for the application. We usually ask for some information about your credit history and income. If you want to get started, there is a form you can fill in now. It won't take long. We just need to know your personal information, like your name, current address, phone number, Social Security number and such. We can start the process today, and we'll call you in a few days.

00:04:43,560

All right. Can I have the form, please?

00:04:46,840

That is the end of part one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
